spans: 12. TERM 12.1 Term and Termination. (a) Unless earlier terminated pursuant to the provisions hereof, the term of this Agreement and the licenses and other grants of rights (and related obligations) under this Agreement shall (i) with respect to the Arizona Licensed Trademarks, be for the Arizona Trademark License Term, (ii) with respect to the Diamond Licensed Trademarks, be for the Diamond Trademark License Term, (iii) with respect to the Phase- Out Marks, be for the term set forth in Section 6.6, and (iv) with respect to Copyrights, Know-How and Patents, be in perpetuity.
"Arizona Trademark License Term" means the period commencing on the Effective Date and ending twenty-four (24) months thereafter.
"Diamond Trademark License Term" means the period commencing on the Effective Date and ending eighteen (18) months thereafter.
2. ASSIGNMENT OF ARIZONA ASSIGNED IP 2.1 Assignment. Arizona agrees to assign and hereby assigns its entire right, title and interest in and to the Arizona Assigned IP to the Company.

This INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AGREEMENT (this "Agreement"), dated as of December 31, 2018 (the "Effective Date") is entered into by and between Armstrong Flooring, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Seller") and AFI Licensing LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Licensing" and together with Seller, "Arizona") and AHF Holding, Inc. (formerly known as Tarzan HoldCo, Inc.), a Delaware corporation ("Buyer") and Armstrong Hardwood Flooring Company, a Tennessee corporation (the "Company" and together with Buyer the "Buyer Entities") (each of Arizona on the one hand and the Buyer Entities on the other hand, a "Party" and collectively, the "Parties").
Parties.answer: Armstrong Flooring, Inc. ("Seller"); AFI Licensing LLC ("Licensing"); AHF Holding, Inc. ("Buyer"); Armstrong Hardwood Flooring Company ("Company")

notes: Expiration Date is UNDETERMINED because the Agreement's term is split by IP type: perpetual for Copyrights/Know-How/Patents licenses (Section 12.1(a)(iv)), but limited to 24 months (Arizona Trademark License Term) or 18 months (Diamond Trademark License Term) measured from the 12/31/2018 Effective Date for the trademark licenses; there is no single initial-term date for the Agreement as a whole. IP Ownership Assignment is a Yes based on Section 2.1's assignment of Arizona's pre-existing IP to the Company (an M&A carve-out assignment rather than work-for-hire, flagged as borderline under the operational definition).
